meta.unit: dollars (WGT_FACTOR x SHIPMT_VALUE), interstate only, CFS 2012/2017/2022
meta.national: origin -> share of national interstate value of the commodity (>= 0.001)
meta.local: destination -> [top origin, top-supplier share, supplier HHI, records]
meta.gaps: majority links: [d, o, share, r_mi, nearest_k1_mi (A distances), gap_k1_mi, gap_k1_centroid_mi, ratio_k1_centroid, adjacent, persistent]; null = no origin ships at least v
meta.surprise: [o, d, ln(observed/OD:OC:DC fit), bootstrap 5%, 95%, records]; cells with >= 30 records and |ln| >= ln 2
